title: Paystride Earned Wage Access Plan Repeat-Shortfall Protection
content:
**Paystride Earned Wage Access Plan — repeat protection at a missed-recovery review.**

The repeat protection rests on the shortfalls carrying a pay date in the last twelve months, the reviewed payday's included:

| Shortfalls with a pay date in the last twelve months | Highest tier the plan may keep |
|---|---|
| one | the tier one below its current tier |
| two | the tier two below its current tier |
| three or more | Paystride Access Starter only |

A tier named as one or two below the current tier never goes below Paystride Access Starter. A record falls in the last N months when fewer than N whole months separate its date from today, whole months being the difference in calendar months less one when today's day of the month is smaller than that date's.

*Hypothetical:* a plan on Paystride Access Premier whose only shortfall in the last twelve months is the reviewed payday's may keep Paystride Access Preferred; with one earlier shortfall in the window, Paystride Access Plus; with two earlier ones, only Paystride Access Starter. A plan on Paystride Access Plus with two shortfalls in the window may keep Paystride Access Starter, two below being Paystride Access Starter.
